decision: Correct the live operating policy: attempt, session, build, checker and elapsed-time counts are observational and cannot terminate unfinished work. Preserve pilot 1 as frozen history, then finish its unchanged scientific question through PIPELINE-COMPLETENESS-PILOT-2 with engineering repair and retry inside the item.

categories.assessment: The intended-object sentinel remains the most direct reusable assurance method. Persistent execution corrects the operational failure without changing the scientific matrix.
Pilot 1 produced tested parser, sentinel and fault-construction assets but no export observation. The live continuation must now execute those assets rather than close on engineering counters.
The failure is local controller configuration and warrants local repair, not an upstream action or terminal report. A completed matrix can support a later contribution decision.

The continuation reuses the frozen Arena producer/adapters, host-native supervisor and pilot-1 parser. Valid-term generation remains valuable but still needs independent typing-rule and generator review.

The invalid generated manifest is diagnosed and regression-fixed. The passing configuration preflight is an entry gate; if it or later engineering work fails, the item remains active for repair and retry.

candidates.rationale: READY. It inherits exact scientific inputs and failure history, has no attempt budget, and requires a passing configuration receipt before building and executing the fixed eight-cell matrix.
The positive-term generator remains valuable but is less ready than finishing the already implemented checked-object sentinel.

blockers.reason: Bind independently reviewed typing rules, a generator reuse decision, exporter support and a staged construction protocol before promotion.
